name: Ezra
author: Not named in the text. Tradition names Ezra.
setting: Jewish exiles return to Jerusalem under Persian rule and rebuild the temple.
theme: God keeps his promise to bring his people home, and his people must be rebuilt in obedience to the law.

outline.label: The first return and the temple
The journey and the exiles who returned

christInBook: The return from exile and the rebuilding of the temple point to a greater restoration. Ezra’s study and teaching of the law anticipate Christ, the final teacher of God’s word.
howToRead: Ezra covers two returns, one under Zerubbabel and one under Ezra himself. Notice the strong role of Scripture, prayer, and confession in rebuilding.
